title: Choice dialog
responsibility: Opens supplied choices beside their trigger in a keyboard-accessible modal, preserving panel headings and viewport bounds.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.label
inputs.description: Accessible name set as aria-label on both the trigger button and the modal dialog. It is required and is not rendered as visible text.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.title
inputs.description: Tooltip text set as the title attribute of the opening trigger button only. It is required and is not applied to the dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.disabled
inputs.description: Passed to the trigger button as its disabled state; the component's default is false. Changing it does not close an already-open dialog, because nothing else in the component reads it.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.activeCount
inputs.description: How many things the icon stands for are under way; the value is forwarded unchanged to the trigger's data-active attribute. The component sets no default for it, so an undefined value is passed through as undefined.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.width
inputs.description: The widest the dialog may be, in pixels, set as the --picker-width custom property. The dialog's CSS width is the smaller of this value and the viewport width minus 24 pixels.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.maxHeight
inputs.description: The tallest the dialog may be, in pixels, set as the --picker-height custom property; when the dialog is placed, its inline max-height becomes the smaller of this value and the space above or below the trigger, and overflow scrolls. The stylesheet's 100dvh minus 24 pixels cap applies only while no inline max-height is set.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.gap
inputs.description: Grid gap in pixels between the direct children of the dialog body, set as the --picker-gap custom property. It defaults to 6 and does not apply to the footer row.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.icon
inputs.description: Snippet rendered inside the trigger button and called with no arguments. It is required, and the trigger always renders it.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.onopen
inputs.description: Called each time the trigger opens the dialog, after the dialog is shown and placed and before focus moves to the selected choice. Its return value is not awaited, so any work it starts is not waited for.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.children
inputs.description: Snippet rendered inside the dialog body and called with a close function that closes only this dialog. It is required, and the choices inside it use that close function to dismiss the dialog.

inputs.name: ChoiceDialog.footer
inputs.description: Optional snippet rendered in a sticky action row at the end of the dialog and called with the same close function as children; when it is omitted, no footer row is rendered. When it is provided, the dialog also receives the with-footer class, which sets scroll-padding-block-end to 80px.

outputs.name: ChoiceDialog
outputs.description: The trigger button and a modal dialog anchored to the trigger's left edge (clamped to the viewport) and placed above or below it, kept clear of the first header in the nearest enclosing aside when placed above, with overflow scrolling. Opening focuses the first element inside the dialog that matches [aria-pressed="true"]:enabled; Escape or a backdrop click (a click whose target is the dialog element itself) closes only this dialog, never an enclosing panel, and returns focus to the trigger.

errors.name: Native dialog error
errors.description: The dialog.showModal() call in open() can throw when the browser cannot put the dialog into its modal state, which rejects the promise returned by open(). The component does not catch or suppress that exception.

errors.name: Caller snippet or callback error
errors.description: Errors thrown while the icon, children or footer snippets render propagate, and the component does not catch them. A synchronous error from onopen rejects the promise returned by open(), while a promise returned by onopen is not awaited and its rejection is not caught by the component.
